messages.content: What is the best month to visit Hawaii?

message.content:
The best time to visit Hawaii largely depends on what you’re looking for—mild weather, fewer crowds, or lower prices.

**Peak tourist season (June–August)**  
- Warmest temperatures (80–90 °F / 27–32 °C)  
- Highest rainfall (especially in June)  
- Most crowded beaches and higher accommodation rates  

**Shoulder seasons (May, September, October)**  
- Pleasant temperatures (70–85 °F / 21–29 °C)  
- Lower rainfall than summer months  
- Fewer tourists, better deals on flights and hotels  

**Off‑season (November–April)**  
- Cooler temperatures (60–75 °F / 15–24 °C)  
- Higher chance of rain, especially December–March  
- Lowest prices but also the most unpredictable weather  

If you want the best balance of comfortable weather, lower crowds, and reasonable prices, **late spring (May–June) and early fall (September–October)** are usually considered the optimal windows. If you’re after the absolute warmest conditions and don’t mind the crowds, mid‑summer (July–August) works well.
